title: The Signature Veteran Student Services Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Veteran education support, advising, and campus resources. The Veteran Student Services Database records campus resources for veteran and military-connected students: veterans' advising offices, published benefit-certification procedures, tutoring and counseling tailored to veterans, and links to official veterans' benefit guidance. The Signature side adds transition guides for moving from service to student life.
capabilities: Record veterans' advising offices with contacts
Document benefit-certification procedures from published sources
Link to official veterans' benefit guidance
List veteran-specific tutoring and counseling options
Provide service-to-campus transition guides

title: The Signature Veteran Student Services Database — Connection layer: public to Signature record mapping
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. The connection layer links records across both sides. Public record JAH-CDB-VETERANS-NNNNNN maps to Signature record JAH-CDBS-VETERANS-NNNNNN by shared record number; provenance is tracked per record and never mixed. The student AI searches both sides through this mapping.
